output.sql: SELECT p.category, ROUND(SUM(l.net_amount), 2) AS net_revenue FROM marts.fct_order_lines AS l JOIN marts.fct_orders AS o ON o.order_id = l.order_id JOIN marts.dim_products AS p ON p.product_id = l.product_id WHERE o.is_revenue GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY net_revenue DESC
output.explanation: Ranks product categories by net revenue (after discounts, excluding shipping) in EUR, counting only lines of completed orders. It covers the whole data period, 2024-01-01 to 2025-12-31, with the highest category first.
